brief.topic: Sahih al-Bukhari 6406: two phrases light on the tongue
brief.audience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on

coreInsight: Sahih al-Bukhari 6406 names two short phrases that are easy on the tongue, heavy in the balance and dear to the Most Merciful.

hooks.notes: Fits the series: a pause before scrolling.
Echoes the hadith; better after it.

selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

scenes.onScreen: Got ten seconds? / Spend them on this.

scenes.purpose: Teaching: the source, verbatim, with its reference.
scenes.excerpt: There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah), and they are, 'Subhan Allah Al- `Azim and 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi
scenes.arabicExcerpt: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ

resolved.arabic: حَدَّثَنَا زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ فُضَيْلٍ، عَنْ عُمَارَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي زُرْعَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ " كَلِمَتَانِ خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ، حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ ".
resolved.english: Narrated Abu Huraira: The Prophet (ﷺ) said, "There are two expressions which are very easy for the tongue to say, but they are very heavy in the balance and are very dear to The Beneficent (Allah), and they are, 'Subhan Allah Al- `Azim and 'Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi
